bug_semantics: The REST frontend registered an /engine-ui proxy whose request path supplied both the destination host and port. EngineUIProxyServlet parsed /engine-ui/<host>:<port>/..., then constructed and issued an HTTP request to that destination without an enable/disable gate or destination allowlist. A remote requester able to reach the proxy could therefore make the Kyuubi server contact arbitrary hosts reachable from the server, yielding SSRF/open-proxy behavior.
flaw_origin: PR #4795 was squash-landed as 4cd00a8777043fca4348d2c2f3a2b0b6e358e028, but its first member commit 3b0152f33b2c03ddd2b86c6ec8541661e01b039a is the smallest real BIC: it created EngineUIProxyServlet, parsed an untrusted host and port from the URI, constructed the target URL from them, registered /engine-ui, and attached the handler to the REST server. Later PR members merely revised the same already-vulnerable proxy implementation.
ai_marker: absent — `git cat-file commit 3b0152f33b2c03ddd2b86c6ec8541661e01b039a` shows human author `zwangsheng <2213335496@qq.com>`, human committer `Cheng Pan <chengpan@apache.org>`, a GPG signature, and only the subject `[KYUUBI #3420][UI] Proxy Engnie UI`; there are no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Assisted-by, bot, or other AI-attribution trailers in the BIC commit object.
evidence: Apache's advisory (https://lists.apache.org/thread/ps79fcfx49ox9kwgztc5t5bw0tyhck9m) states that versions 1.8.0 before 1.12.0 accept a host and port from the Engine UI proxy path and can be induced to send requests to arbitrary reachable hosts; it directs users to 1.12.0.

The PR #4795 patch (https://github.com/apache/kyuubi/pull/4795.patch) exposes all eight member commits of squash 4cd00a8777043fca4348d2c2f3a2b0b6e358e028. Patch 1/8, 3b0152f33b2c03ddd2b86c6ec8541661e01b039a, adds kyuubi-server/src/main/scala/org/apache/kyuubi/server/api/EngineUIProxyServlet.scala and its getTargetAddress/rewriteTarget logic, adds getEngineUIProxyHandler with /engine-ui context in ApiRootResource.scala, and registers that handler in KyuubiRestFrontendService.scala. Patches 2/8 through 8/8 change an already-present proxy rather than introduce the communication channel.

The fetched BIC commit object reports parent cb689b66b1ed745a5e38dea37a2b0f1d9e7f1aca, author zwangsheng, committer Cheng Pan, and no AI-attribution trailer. The GitHub commit view (https://github.com/apache/kyuubi/commit/3b0152f33b2c03ddd2b86c6ec8541661e01b039a) independently shows EngineUIProxyServlet as a new 84-line file and the route/server attachment in the same commit.

Direct parent-tree verification with `git ls-tree -r --name-only cb689b66b1ed745a5e38dea37a2b0f1d9e7f1aca -- <three proxy paths>` lists KyuubiRestFrontendService.scala and ApiRootResource.scala but not EngineUIProxyServlet.scala. Thus the vulnerable servlet file and its target-building lines are absent from the BIC's immediate parent; the BIC diff adds both the /engine-ui route and server attachment.

Local history `git log --follow -- kyuubi-server/src/main/scala/org/apache/kyuubi/server/api/EngineUIProxyServlet.scala` begins on the mainline at squash 4cd00a8777043fca4348d2c2f3a2b0b6e358e028. `git log -S'new URL("http", host, port' -- <file>` identifies that squash as the mainline introduction and 7067644e1bf469a761b0516ce73b432a2ebf9f9d as the restricting change; decomposing the squash moves the BIC to member 3b0152f33b2c03ddd2b86c6ec8541661e01b039a rather than leaving it at the aggregate.

Fix PR #7483 (https://github.com/apache/kyuubi/pull/7483) landed as 7067644e1bf469a761b0516ce73b432a2ebf9f9d. Its diff adds kyuubi.frontend.rest.engine.ui.proxy.enabled with default false and kyuubi.frontend.rest.engine.ui.proxy.hosts with default empty, constructs EngineUIProxyServlet from those settings, and rejects targets unless proxying is enabled and the normalized host matches an allowed pattern.

`git tag --contains 4cd00a8777043fca4348d2c2f3a2b0b6e358e028` includes v1.8.0 and every later 1.8.x/1.9.x/1.10.x/1.11.x tag, while `git tag --contains 7067644e1bf469a761b0516ce73b432a2ebf9f9d` begins at v1.12.0. The peeled boundary tags are v1.8.0 -> aaef532491f75891e00b30ce77ddd35145ced4b3 and v1.12.0 -> bca17a7b5cfa0d32440832f5611f922164644943, matching the advisory's affected and patched boundaries.
reasoning: The vulnerability is the proxy's trust-boundary error, not merely a URL-parsing detail: an externally supplied URI segment became the server-side HTTP destination with no policy limiting endpoint choice. The complete usable proxy channel first exists in PR member 3b0152f33b2c03ddd2b86c6ec8541661e01b039a, which simultaneously creates the servlet, extracts host/port, builds the target, mounts /engine-ui, and registers the handler. Its direct parent lacks the new servlet and route additions. Although the project mainline records the PR as squash 4cd00a8777043fca4348d2c2f3a2b0b6e358e028, the published eight-member patch series reconstructs the smaller causal commit; subsequent members refactor or polish an already-exploitable mechanism. The squash is contained in v1.8.0, and the direct restriction commit is first contained in v1.12.0, so repository history agrees with the published version range. Finally, BIC attribution is judged solely from 3b0152f33b2c03ddd2b86c6ec8541661e01b039a's commit object: it has human author and committer identities and no AI marker or trailer. Therefore the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
